jets.setting: Any orthogonal reflection commuting with heat and the full Leray nonlinearity; initial velocity is reflection-odd.
jets.energy_coefficient: C/3, C=<N(u0),DN(u0)DN(u0)N(u0)>; <N,D2N[N,N]>=0 by incompressible kinetic cancellation
jets.scope: Free-algebra identities checked; reflection equivariance, PDE smoothness and Hilbert Taylor passage are analytic.

physical.domain: T3=(R/(2pi Z))^3, circular data supported transversely in r<5/2<pi
physical.canonical_pressure: p0(r)+eps*(2chi+r chi_prime)*cos(kz)/k, p0_prime=r*f0; subtract its mean
physical.generated_parent: N(u0)=eps*(-k r chi cos(kz),0,(2chi+r chi_prime)sin(kz)) in cylindrical components
physical.exact_return: C=-2pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^3 chi^2*(4f0+r f0_prime) dr
physical.growing_example: f0=r^-6 on supp chi: C=4pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^-3 chi^2 dr>0
physical.depleting_example: f0=1 on supp chi: C=-8pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^3 chi^2 dr<0
physical.generality: Any smooth nonzero compact circular swirl has an annulus with decreasing squared angular momentum, permitting the growing construction.

explicit.base: b_base=psi(r)*r^-3, psi smooth, equal one on [1,2], supported in (1/2,5/2)
explicit.ratio_bound: |eps*a/f0|<=3008/10000<1/2 on the modulation support; zero outside
explicit.conclusion: The actual even-parent energy exceeds its original caloric forecast on a nonzero short interval at every fixed nu>0.
explicit.not_claimed: No uniform time window, repeated renewal, growing total kinetic energy, whole-space realization, or singularity follows.

status: Analytic actual unforced periodic history theorem with exact pressure, parity, integral and positivity checks; not a new Lean certificate.
